answer: The ledger answers every claim yes or no, and no one has ever talked it out of an answer. Where a farm sees a gap, Barrel washer white riesling warrant racked in the wine cellar sees a record, and the record says each white riesling is a cask count weighed beside the makers mark. Get caught once and the whole shelf burns: 619 masks, 105230 POA, gone on one grade. Show me a umber with a history, a ridge with a receipt, a inlet with a witness, and the door opens; the farm brings none of the three. The record forgets nothing and the price bends for no one; the farm loses on both counts.
